verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform that holds sensitive customer financial data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training policies, data-use opt-outs, or controls over how customer data feeds AI models. The pack covers only banking features (accounts, cards, invoicing, integrations) and an llms.txt file, which concerns AI crawler access to support docs, not training on customer data.
